text: an harlot: Heb. a woman, an harlot
from: Heb. from the face | in process of time: Heb. after days
be witness between us: Heb. be hearer between us
whatsoever cometh forth: Heb. that which cometh forth shall come forth | and I will offer it: Or, I will offer it, etc.
beside her he had neither son nor daughter: Or, he had not of his own either son or daughter. Heb. of himself
go up and down: Heb. go, and go down
yearly: Heb. from year to year | to lament: Or, to talk with
